title: Jeeene ke Zamane Me Qasim Maidaan Me Marne Jaatey Hai
body:
Jeeene ke zamane me Qasim maidaan me marne jaatey hai
Shabbir dar e khaima pe khade aankhou se lahoo barsaatey hain
1. Bhai ki wasiyat per humko karna hai amal aye mere jaari
Abbas se dilawar se rokeryeh sibte nabi farmatey hain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kohraam bapa hai foujao mein hilti hai zameen e karbobala
Hyder ki tarah ran me Qasim andaz e wega dekhlatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ek hasr bapa hai maidaan mein hulchal hai yazeedi lashker mein
Ghoode se gira ran mein Qasim shabbir madad ko jaatey hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghoudon ke sumoo se is darja pamaal huwa Qasim ka badan
Chader mein lapete lashe ko phulou ki tarah sheh laatey hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khaimein mein shah e deen se fizza yeh ahle haram se kehti thi
Farwa ke pisar ko godi mein shabbir utha ke laate hain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kya baat huwi kyu hota hai shadi ke gharane me matam
Kyun chaak gariban rootey huwe Qasim ke barati aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ansaar e hussaini pyase hai pyasi hai dulhan pyasa dulha
Har saal yeh shadi kr manzer har ahle aza ko rulatey hain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aye ahle aza soucho toh zara jis tarha se kubra ne pehna
Is tarha randaap e ka jooda dulhan ko kahi pehnate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Yeh faiz e hussaini hai mazher kehte hain farishte roz e jazan
Suraj ki tarha matam ke nisaan taqdeer teri chamkatey hain
Azz..Mazher Abedi..
